scope: Offline C2-A only; no C2-B/C3, product dependency, interface or format change

saturated_volume.COSTALD: Hankinson-Thomson 1979; Vstar cubic-root mixing, Tcm=sum(x*sqrt(Tc*Vstar))^2/Vstar_mix, omega_SRK mole average; cross interaction explicitly zero
saturated_volume.modified_Rackett: ChEDL 1.5.2 Rackett_mixture mass-weighted mixing; Tcm and ZRA mole averages; pure limit is modified Rackett, no estimated ZRA

pressure_correction: Both candidates use Thomson-Brobst-Hankinson Tait with COSTALD Tcm/Vstar/omega mixing and Pcm=(0.291-0.080*omega_SRK)*R*Tcm/Vstar for ALL compositions, including pure and zero-padded states. No component-count branch or normalization. Generalized Riedel coefficient 4.86601. The generalized endpoint Pcm is a correlation parameter, not a replacement for the physical Pc stored in parameters.json or used in modified Rackett saturated volumes.
saturation_observations: Explicit saturated/bubble liquid observations compare saturated volume directly; measured pressure is retained but not used as an arbitrary TP correction anchor. All other TP inputs use full Tait factor.

domain.additional: For compressed inputs P >= correlation Psat; otherwise unavailable, no pressure clamp, root substitution or saturated-volume fallback. Saturation rows use T selection only, as accepted baseline.
domain.composition_note: Experimental selection remains the accepted 0.2–0.8 liquid range; engineering uses actual PR liquid compositions, including outside that selection, without asserting a continuous qualified domain.

engineering: Exactly the accepted 276-row engineering input matrix; preserve gas flow/density and PR beta/x, recompute liquid rho and Q from PR phase molar flow and candidate molar volume. HEOS comparison remains model screening, not experiment. Missing candidate points remain recorded. Same 0.1/1/10 flow scales, two geometries and S1/S2 API.
failure_policy: Keep all baseline cases/exclusions and phase anomalies by immutable reference. No fitting, new kij, volume translation, threshold relaxation, shrinking continuous domain, or qualification of VLE/gas density from liquid density improvement.

Cargo.lock.reason: Subsequent approved repository development changed Cargo.lock; original manifest and all original validation files/harness/S1/S2 modules remain unchanged. This is replay with the current locked harness, not byte-identical reconstruction of the 2026-10-22 build environment.

change_from_previous: Only pressure pseudo-critical Pc/Pcm selection changes. Dedicated parameters and saturated volumes remain identical; old pressure branch, reports, failures and all four manifests are immutable. This is a separately named offline candidate, not a correction of old results.

boundary_validation.pressure_probe: 1 MPa and P=Ps times (1-1e-8, 1, 1+1e-8). Preserve original TP bounds: boundary probes outside them are recorded unavailable; algebraic Tait(P=Ps)=1 tested separately.
boundary_validation.tolerance_role: Floating-point continuity regression only, not an experimental accuracy threshold or qualified continuous domain.
